plugins.name: kaga-ult-build
plugins.description: Master build orchestrator for premium client websites. Runs a nine-agent crew (art direction, UX, frontend, motion, backend, content/SEO, security, UAT, integration) through Plan then Act then Audit then Launch, routing every phase to the installed specialist skills rather than reimplementing them. Enforces a 10-site reference hunt before any design work, researched colour palettes and typography with stated contrast ratios, a resolved image plan, zero framework defaults, a three-pass audit, and a costed client quote. Use for any new site, redesign, landing page, or major visual feature.
